seoTitle: How to Translate Reviews on Shopify (Best App)
metaDescription: Translate product reviews on Shopify into your customers' local languages using dedicated review translation apps to boost trust.
intro: If you sell to international customers, showing product reviews in their native language can build a lot more trust than leaving everything in one language. This guide covers different methods for translating reviews on Shopify and what to look for in a good review translation app.

steps.heading: Install a review translation app
steps.body: Search the Shopify App Store for an app that specializes in translating product reviews automatically.

steps.heading: Connect the app to your review platform
steps.body: Link the translation app to whichever review app you're already using to collect and display reviews.

steps.heading: Set target languages
steps.body: Choose which languages you want reviews translated into based on where your customers are located.

steps.heading: Review translated content
steps.body: Check a sample of translated reviews to make sure the translations read naturally and accurately.

steps.heading: Display translated reviews on product pages
steps.body: Confirm the translated reviews appear correctly for customers browsing in their local language.

faq.question: Are review translations automatic or manual?
faq.answer: Most review translation apps use automatic machine translation, though some may offer manual review options for accuracy.

faq.question: Will translating reviews slow down my product pages?
faq.answer: Well-built translation apps generally cache translations so they don't noticeably slow down page load times.

faq.question: Can I choose which languages to translate reviews into?
faq.answer: Yes, most apps let you select specific target languages based on your store's customer base.

faq.question: Do translated reviews still show the original language option?
faq.answer: Many apps let customers toggle between the original and translated review text, though this depends on the specific app you use.
